# Verxor

> Verxor is a digital services platform providing virtual phone numbers for SMS verification, number rentals, social account boosting (SMM), proxies, eSIM data profiles, gift card trading, virtual USD cards, Nigerian VTU (airtime & data), exam pins, electricity tokens, betting wallet funding, cable TV subscriptions, and partner VTU API access.

## Primary products & services

- Virtual Numbers: Instant SMS verification numbers for supported platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, Instagram, and more). https://verxor.com/services/virtual-numbers
- Number Rentals: Dedicated virtual numbers for a defined rental period with renewal visibility. https://verxor.com/services/number-rentals
- Boost Account (SMM): Social media marketing packages for supported platforms. https://verxor.com/services/smm
- Accounts & Logs: Marketplace listings for supported account categories. https://verxor.com/services/accounts-logs
- Proxies: Residential and datacenter proxy options for permitted network workflows. https://verxor.com/services/proxies
- eSIM: Global digital SIM data profiles with compatibility guidance. https://verxor.com/services/esim
- Sell Gift Cards: Trade supported gift cards at displayed rates. https://verxor.com/services/gift-cards
- Virtual Dollar Cards: Virtual USD card issuance for online payments. https://verxor.com/services/virtual-cards
- Airtime: Nigerian mobile airtime top-up. https://verxor.com/services/airtime
- Data: Nigerian mobile data bundles. https://verxor.com/services/data
- Exam Pin: Registration and result-checker pins for supported exam bodies. https://verxor.com/services/exam-pin
- Electricity: Prepaid tokens and postpaid bill payments for supported discos. https://verxor.com/services/electricity
- Bet Wallet Funding: Top up supported sports-betting wallets. https://verxor.com/services/bet-funding
- Cable TV: DStv, GOtv, StarTimes and other supported subscriptions. https://verxor.com/services/cable-tv
- VTU API: Partner API for airtime, data and utilities. https://verxor.com/services/vtu-api
